# Agent Lifecycle Kit

> Eval-Driven Development (EDD) for AI agents—plus autonomous architecture & governance for Cursor, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Windsurf, and GitHub Copilot.

## Core Features
- **Eval-Driven Development (EDD)**: TDD for tool-using agents—YAML suites, JSONL datasets, mocked MCP tools, schema/routing asserts, LLM-as-a-judge, CI threshold gates, Markdown failure traces, OTel + prod→JSONL
- Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters) & DDD domain invariant enforcement
- TDD Short Loops & Quality Guardrails
- 20+ specialized lifecycle role skills (agent-spec, agent-tdd, agent-security, agent-arch-drift, agent-telemetry)
- Language & framework profiles (TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python, Java, C#, Next.js, React, Express, Spring Boot)
- Unified kit CLI for application bootstrapping and automated security/eval auditing
- CLI: `kit eval run|watch|report|ci` (alias: `agent-kit`)
